functions.lever: volatile short locals latching the sub BG0/BG1 control reads (strh sp / ldrsh sp pairs), field184 zeroed before them, flags = 0 then flags |= 2, slot pointer declared outside the final loop
functions.notes: Byte-exact (wgate MATCH), 11 gate/diff runs. QUALITY BAR DEVIATION: the two dead ldrsh/strh stack pairs and sub sp,#8 are only produced by `volatile short v0, v1;` locals read as `v0;` statements after the BG0CNTSUB/BG1CNTSUB latch (same idiom as merged Overlay_1 func_ov001_0216297c). Without them the function is 0x360 vs 0x378 bytes. No natural non-volatile form found (plain locals, inline setters, direct macro copy all emit no stack traffic). Reviewer may reject on the volatile-local rule.
